news.Title: Alphabet, Apple, and Meta Platforms Were Top Billionaire Investor Buys in Q2. Should Retail Investors Follow Suit?
news.Content:
Billionaire investors were busy in Q2 buying shares of tech titans Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOGL) (NASDAQ: GOOG), Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL), and Meta Platforms (NASDAQ: META). The three are among the largest companies in the world, with some of the most iconic tech businesses on the planet.

Let's dive into why these three growth stocks remain attractive investments that were recently bought by billionaire investors.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Alphabet

Alphabet saw some big-name billionaire investors buy the stock in Q2, with the likes of Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway and Renaissance Technologies' Jim Simons adding to their holdings during the quarter.

There are many reasons to like Alphabet. The company's core Google search business continues to have a large distribution moat through its ownership of the Chrome browser and Android smartphone operating system, as well as a revenue-sharing deal to be the default browser on Apple devices. Meanwhile, AI-powered tools, such as AI mode and AI Overviews, have increased queries and driven revenue growth.

In addition, the company's cloud computing business has been the fastest-growing of the big three cloud providers, with revenue surging 82% last quarter. The company also has a significant advantage in this area with its tensor processing units (TPUs), which give it a significant cost advantage over rivals that largely rely on graphics processing units (GPUs). The company has even started selling TPUs outside Google Cloud to select large customers, such as Anthropic, adding another high-margin revenue stream.

As the most complete AI company with top chips and models, Alphabet looks like a long-term AI winner.

Apple

Another stock that saw some billionaire buying in Q2 was Apple, with George Soros and Jeff Gendell of Tontine Partners both adding shares. While Apple's stock is not cheap, the company has arguably one of the best compounding business models on the planet.

The secret to Apple's business model is its closed ecosystem. Once a consumer buys an Apple device and starts taking photos, buying apps, and subscribing, they tend to get locked in. This, in turn, leads to greater use of high-margin Apple services, such as cloud storage, commissions on app purchases and subscriptions, and Apple Pay. The company also makes a tremendous profit from its revenue-sharing deal with Alphabet, under which it gets a 36% cut of search ad revenue generated by queries through its Safari browser.

Story Continues

Apple maintains a strong leadership position at the high end of the smartphone, PC, and device markets, all of which tend to have predictable replacement cycles. This creates a relatively repetitive revenue stream, while its services business continues to consistently compound at a high rate of return. Given this business model, Apple is a top stock to own long-term.

Meta Platforms

Meta was a popular buy among hedge fund billionaires in Q2, with Bill Ackman, Jim Simons, and Lee Anslie of Maverick Capital, among the buyers. It's easy to see why hedge funds were scooping up shares of the social media giant last quarter. The stock has been beaten down on concerns of its aggressive spending on AI infrastructure and is only trading at a forward P/E of 16 times 2027 analyst estimates.

Meta has been one of the best companies at harnessing the power of AI to drive growth at its core business. Its social media platform is a great flywheel business, where AI keeps users on the platform longer while also helping advertisers serve more relevant ads and achieve better conversions. This is leading to both more ad impressions and higher ad prices. Meanwhile, the company has been making great strides in its AI models, and CEO Mark Zuckerberg has big ambitions.

news.Title: 力成PiFO明年中量產拚規模經濟，較CoWoS L具成本效益，良率更勝EMIB
news.Content:
【財訊快報／記者李純君報導】先進封裝戰役開打，力成(6239)PiFO就位，預計明年中旬整合大客戶ASIC與HBM晶片的FOPLP產線正式量產，此產線概念上類似CoWoS L，但排版上是方形，更具成本效益，良率更可勝過英特爾的EMIB。依外資圈估算，此產業明年中旬正式量產達，規模經濟的損平後，至少一年將替力成帶入3元起跳的每股淨利。力成的FOPLP產線，實驗線在2016年成立、2018年研發完成，2021年決定蓋廠，2023年產線就位，其製程技術就是panel RDL，再進行oS，成就「方的CoWoS」。

更具體來說，目前在AI的先進封裝中，耳熟能詳的主要是台積電(2330)的CoWoS，以及英特爾的EMIB，而力成今日宣布自家的PiFO，明年中旬就會獲得大客戶量產，並達到規模經濟。

力成的PiFO，是先在Panel上製作底層RDL重布線，與CoWoS和EMIB很大差別，在於以矽材料的bridge die（橋接晶片／矽橋）將ASIC與HBM做連結，此外也以Micro bump取代Hybrid bump，並在molding表面繼續製作上層RDL，完成後，再做on substrate製程，形成完整封裝模組，將整個模組裝配到ABF substrate上。

這項技術的特色，是透過Panel製程在封裝內建立多層RDL，再將不同晶粒整合成一個大型模組。特色除了上述的以bridge die做主晶片連結外，與台積電的CoWoS不同在於，是方形排版，510X515的尺寸，一片可以產出45~90顆，產出效益大。與英特爾的EMIB最大不同點，在於oS段使用一般性的ABF載板，不是EMIB的載板挖洞的嵌入式載板，PiFO良率高。

力成也證實，自家的PiFO技術，已經獲得某美系客戶採用，將在2027年中旬正式量產，主要是整合ASIC與HBM的AI晶片封裝，後續也將會推進到新加坡替另外的客戶同樣量產ASIC與HBM的AI晶片。

業界則分析，力成的面板級封裝產線，設置產線的投入資金超過200億元，目前處於虧損，一年侵蝕每股淨利約3元，待明年中旬達到量產規模經濟後，將有望在一年貢獻力成至少3塊以上的每股淨利，甚至替公司帶入新的獲利成長空間。

news.Title: 《韓股》KOSPI指數漲近1% 重返6800點
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-26 16:42:28 數位內容中心 發佈

韓股今(26)日走勢分歧，韓國KOSPI指數收於6,808.21點，上漲65.47點或0.97%；韓國KOSDAQ指數收於826.87點，下跌0.28點或0.03%。盤面主軸仍是重大事件前的觀望，但美國10年期與30年期公債殖利率回檔、國際油價下跌，帶動風險偏好回升，支撐KOSPI指數站回6,800點之上。

宏觀環境方面，市場焦點集中在NVIDIA財報、美國7月PCE物價指數與韓國央行金融通貨委員會，投資人傾向先等待結果再調整部位。KOSPI指數盤中一度衝高至6,887.18點，之後漲勢收斂，但整體仍維持偏強格局；KOSDAQ指數則在震盪後幾乎持平。

權值股方面，KOSPI指數上漲主要來自大型股回穩與機構買盤推升，Samsung Electronics(005930.KS)與SK hynix(000660.KS)的自家股票買回相關買盤成為市場焦點。Samsung Life Insurance(032830.KS)、Samsung C&T(028260.KS)、Samsung Biologics(207940.KS)同步走高，Hyundai Motor(005380.KS)、Samsung Electro-Mechanics(009150.KS)與SK Square(402340.KS)則偏弱，顯示資金仍集中在少數權值族群。

news.Title: 《日股》風險偏好回升 日經漲0.62%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-26 16:35:48 數位內容中心 發佈

日股今(26)日續揚，日經225指數收於66,262.16點，上漲405.73點或0.62%；東證股價指數(TOPIX)收於4,111.02點，上漲17.35點或0.42%。盤面先受到AI相關股獲利了結壓抑，但隨中東戰事升溫疑慮降溫、油價與美國長期利率回檔，買盤回流，帶動大盤由弱轉強。

外部環境方面，油價走低與美國長期利率下滑，緩和了通膨與資金成本壓力，也推升風險偏好；同時，美股上一個交易日走高，為日股提供支撐。不過，投資人仍在觀望Nvidia財報與Jackson Hole會議相關訊息，追價力道因此偏保守。

權值股方面，日經225指數早盤一度開低，之後在買盤回補下翻紅並維持高檔震盪。愛德萬測試(6857.JP)推升日經225指數，軟銀集團(9984.JP)、Recruit Holdings(6098.JP)與Sony Group(6758.JP)也走高，成為指數重要支撐；相較之下，Kioxia Holdings(285A.JP)、TDK(6762.JP)與Lasertec(6920.JP)等AI相關個股偏弱，顯示族群內部出現分歧。

類股方面，證券商品期貨、醫藥、銀行與保險類股表現較佳，帶動TOPIX同步走升；海運與石油煤炭製品類股則偏弱，反映油價回檔對相關族群形成壓力，也讓資金更集中流向金融與防禦性標的。

news.Title: 恆生指數週三上揚141.87點或0.56%，輝達財報倒數與阿里AI布局成焦點
news.Content:
【財訊快報／劉敏夫】香港股市週三走升，因在投資人等待輝達財報發布之際，週二美股、中概股表現亮眼，為買盤營造良好的進場氛圍，加上馬雲增持阿里巴巴股票等利多捎來，也進一步助長市場多頭氣勢。收盤時，恆生指數上揚141.87點或0.56%，報25,652.97點；恆生中國企業股指數則是上漲88.47點或1.05%，報8,533.84點。

恆生指數四大類股指數漲跌不一，其中工商業類股指數上揚0.77%，表現最好，其餘類股表現分別為，地產類股指數上漲0.70%；金融類股指數上升0.23%；公共事業類股指數則是下滑0.29%。

輝達週三美股盤後將發布季度業績，分析師普遍預測其營收增速將繼續領先大多數同行。週二輝達股價在七連跌後反彈，美股大盤指數標普500指數和追蹤中概股的金龍中國指數同樣收升。

此外，市場繼續聚焦阿里巴巴股價表現，公司主席蔡崇信連續第二天買入公司股票，創辦人之一的馬雲據稱近期也買入超過6億港幣的阿里巴巴股票，展現對AI佈局的支持。

其他消息方面，老鋪黃金上半年收入和利潤成長放緩，金價下跌削弱了中國消費者對其首飾的需求。

中國財政部計畫精準有效實施更加積極的財政政策，發改委副主任表示下半年要更大力釋放內需潛力。

在個股表現方面，信達生物股價上漲9.69%；安踏體育股價上漲9.53%；吉利汽車股價下跌3.27%；申洲國際股價下跌7.78%。

news.Title: 台股大漲663點！ 三大法人「全站買方」網嘆：賣飛的舉手
news.Content:
台股今日再度走出強勢反轉行情，早盤一度下跌逾百點，但隨著買盤進場，指數快速翻紅，盤中漲幅持續擴大，終場收在45832點，上漲663點、漲幅1.47%，重新站回4萬5000點整數關卡，成交量也放大至8042億元。三大法人合計買超593.87億。

三大法人聯手大買593億

從盤後籌碼來看，三大法人今日全面站在買方，合計買超593.87億元，較前一交易日明顯轉強，市場法人資金重新回流台股。其中外資及陸資買超365.98億元、投信買超48.55億元，自營商則合計買超179.33億元。

外資買超365億成最大推手

今日法人動向最受矚目的仍是外資，單日買超365.98億元，成為推升大盤的重要力量。PTT股板盤後也出現大量討論，不少網友注意到外資大幅買超，直呼「小兒又回來了」、「大爆買」、「賣飛的舉手」，甚至有人認為外資似乎正在提前布局即將公布的輝達財報行情。不過，也有網友提醒，法人買超不代表短線一定持續上漲，若市場人氣重新過熱，反而可能出現追高後的震盪。

投信轉買ABF族群

投信買超前10大依序為玉山金3984張、大聯大3217張、元大台灣50（0050）2550張、景碩2146張、南電1523張、南亞1453張、興富發1347張、光寶科1186張、聯鈞989張、華通967張。其中，景碩、南電同屬ABF載板族群，加上南亞也獲得投信加碼，顯示法人近期仍持續關注AI、高階PCB與載板相關題材。PTT也有網友注意到，投信近期重新買進ABF族群，留言討論「投信開始回頭買ABF」，市場對載板族群後續表現仍抱有期待。

聯電、國巨遭投信調節

在賣超部分，投信今日持續調節聯電，單日賣超3944張居冠；國巨賣超2874張，第一金賣超1669張，技嘉賣超1236張，潤泰新賣超1110張。此外，華南金賣超1089張、興勤賣超933張、日月光投控賣超801張、臻鼎-KY賣超642張，台積電則遭投信賣超626張。值得注意的是，台股今日大漲逾600點，投信卻仍調節台積電與國巨等個股，顯示法人資金並非全面追價，而是持續進行個股間的汰弱留強。

news.Title: The Market Has Priced Intel Anywhere Between $24 and $142 in the Past 12 Months
news.Content:
Within the past year, the market has valued Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) at $23.68 per share, at $142.35 per share, and at nearly everything in between. As of this writing, shares sit at $87.26 -- about 39% below the high, and still about 3.7 times the low.

That is a sixfold spread within one year for the same company. How much of Intel's price is the business that exists, and how much is a claim on the foundry business Intel is promising to build?

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Image source: Intel.

Two endpoints, one year

The bottom of the range is barely a year old. Shares fell to $23.68 last September, days after the U.S. government agreed to convert $8.9 billion in already-awarded chip grant money into 433.3 million shares at $20.47 apiece (a stake of about 10%). A couple of weeks later, Nvidia announced a $5 billion investment of its own at $23.28 per share.

At the bottom, the whole company was valued at about $105 billion. And the money arriving at those prices wasn't ordinary fund-manager money. The government and Nvidia were backing strategic manufacturing capacity, not chasing near-term earnings.

The top came at the end of June, when shares touched $142.35. That peak arrived about three weeks before Intel reported its fastest revenue growth since 2011, so the market's top price wasn't paying for reported results. It was paying for where the numbers seemed to be headed.

Since then, shares have given back about 39%, even as reported numbers have continued to improve. Intel raised about $23 billion earlier this month, selling new shares at $95 apiece, and the stock now trades well below that price, too.

The business changed less than the price did

To be fair, the business did improve. Revenue grew 25% year over year in the second quarter, to $16.1 billion from $12.9 billion -- growth Intel hadn't shown since 2011. The data center and artificial intelligence (AI) segment grew 59% year over year to $6.3 billion and about 24% from the first quarter alone, indicating accelerating growth as the year went on. Intel Foundry, the manufacturing arm at the center of the turnaround, grew 31% to $5.8 billion. Management, for its part, guided third-quarter revenue to $15.8 billion to $16.8 billion. The company itself expects sales to hold near the new level.

Story Continues

But I'd argue the more important list is what didn't change. Intel Foundry posted a $2.1 billion operating loss for the quarter, despite that growth. The company as a whole lost about $11 billion on a GAAP basis over the past year, largely due to charges. And the foundry's revenue still comes mostly from manufacturing Intel's own products. Outside customers remain a small slice.

In other words, the bottom of the range priced Intel as a broken chipmaker, and the top priced it as a successful foundry -- a business that arguably doesn't exist yet at a profitable scale. The improvement showed up in the numbers, but it explains only a fraction of a repricing that ran from about $105 billion of market value to roughly $700 billion in under 10 months.

Micron makes the same point in reverse

Memory specialist Micron (NASDAQ:MU) shows what the other version of a wild year looks like. Its 52-week range is even wider than Intel's ($114.25 to $1,255, an 11-fold spread), but its move tracked earnings that actually showed up. Trailing-12-month revenue rose 167%, and the company earned more than $44 per share over that period. After all of that, Micron's price works out to about 6 times next year's expected earnings -- the market treating those results as a cyclical peak rather than a lasting new level.

Intel, by comparison, costs about 43 times next year's expected earnings. And that forward price-to-earnings multiple sat above 50 as recently as mid-August, before the latest slide. The market prices this company on a daily basis, not just monthly.

Zoom out, though, and the two spreads are different in kind. Micron's results were the market repricing. Intel's is the market repricing a promise, and a promise can be marked up or down sharply because there are no earnings underneath to anchor it. The turnaround is going better than it did a year ago, and the government and Nvidia now hold stakes that pay off only if it continues. But at about 43 times next year's expected earnings, I think most of what investors are paying for is still the promise. That gap could close from either side -- the results could rise to meet the price, or the price could fall to meet the results. The results, good as they have been, don't carry the price yet.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again

In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. If you'd invested $5,000 then, you'd be sitting on $2,706,997 today.*

Now, for the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. It's a key player in the $1.8 trillion space race, and with the stock recently sitting 20% off its highs, the window to get in early is closing fast.

Continue »

*Stock Advisor returns as of August 3, 2026

由於Nasdaq電子盤跌勢拖累日韓股市今(26)日開低，台股小跌開出後，以獲外資調高評等的聯發科、搭配矽智財股創意亮燈漲停領軍，加上富台指、摩台指週五將結算，激勵權王台積電、載板股欣興/景碩、CCL股台光電、散熱股奇鋐轉強，午盤更在亞股記憶體指標股三星電子、ADVANTEST走強下，南亞科、日月光投控亦見翻紅走勢，使電子前10大權值股僅聯電收黑，而近期強勢的航運、金控股拉回，未對指數構成壓力，加權指數終場收在45832.62點，上漲663.16點或1.47%、收復10日線，成交量增至8042.49億元、日K連二紅。

news.Title: Nvidia Earnings Give Investors a Barometer for State of AI Trade
news.Content:
(Bloomberg) -- Wall Street is eagerly anticipating Nvidia Corp.'s earnings on Wednesday afternoon, not so much for what the numbers will say about the chip giant, but for what they mean to artificial intelligence investors and the market itself.

Most Read from Bloomberg

Lutnick's Intervention in Canada Talks Draws Praise, Blame

Apple Gears Up to Launch Its First New Mac Mini in Two Years

Xi Signals Defiance as US Threatens Sanctions Over Iran Help

US Weighs More Trade Measures Against Canada After Retaliation

Bessent's Mentor Druckenmiller Calls Bond Buying a Mistake

"Nvidia is the best barometer for AI spending," said Rob Conzo, chief executive officer of the Wealth Alliance, which owns Nvidia shares in several portfolios. "It will help determine if hyperscalers are still accelerating, from an infrastructure perspective, or if they're becoming more disciplined."

The company's shares have been on a wild ride this year, sinking through the winter, then soaring through the spring, and bouncing around all summer. They're coming off a seven-day losing streak, matching the longest since 2019, in which they lost 7.5%. And that follows a 19% leap from late July through mid-August.

All told, Nvidia is up 14% in 2026, a decent showing but still a far cry from its past performance. At this time last year, the stock had gained 34%, and in 2024 it was soaring more than 150%. The reason is hardly a secret, with investors increasingly cautious about the durability of the AI trade with inflation remaining high, interest rates rising and geopolitical risks all over the place, whether it's the US's military and economic war with Iran or its trade war with Canada.

The tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 Index suffered its worst month in more than a year in July, falling 6.6% as investors dumped the shares of companies exposed to the AI buildout amid concerns about how much longer the heavy spending would last. But since its July 29 trough, the index has regained much of that lost ground, led by memory and storage companies like Sandisk Corp. and chipmakers such as Marvell Technology Inc.

Wall Street expects Nvidia to deliver stellar results for the fiscal second quarter, which ended July 31. Analysts project that revenue nearly doubled from a year ago, which would be the fastest pace in two years, as did net income, according to data compiled by Bloomberg.

That, however, isn't what the market is focused on. Rather, investors want to hear what Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang has to say about capital spending by its biggest customers, future demand and a spate of new financing deals that involve Nvidia. Price increases will also be top of mind after some of the company's customers were told that the cost of servers with its AI chips will rise more than 15% in some cases, due to surging memory costs.

Story Continues

"This will be a very interesting report, but it isn't so much about the numbers," Conzo said. "The forward guidance discussions will be far more in view."

Earlier this month, Nvidia said it's partnering with Wall Street firms including Goldman Sachs Group Inc., BlackRock Inc. and Apollo Global Management Inc. to provide $500 billion in financing for AI infrastructure. Nvidia also agreed to spend as much as $105 billion to back a data center campus in Ohio that will be leased by OpenAI.

"They're going to need to discuss those two big partnerships or agreements in good detail and sort of calm the market's fears around the circularity of financing," said Shaon Baqui, a senior equity analyst at Janus Henderson, which holds a substantial position in Nvidia.

The big questions from investors are how much of Nvidia's revenue is being driven by its own financing and if it's creating or bringing forward demand. Huang's comments alone likely won't be enough to resolve some of the issues the market is having with AI investments at the moment, according to Daniel Pilling, portfolio manager at Sands Capital Management, which owns the stock.

"It's going to be a really important quarter for them, not because of what they're doing on the balance sheet, but what they're doing off the balance sheet," said Brian Mulberry, chief market strategist at Zacks Investment Management, which holds Nvidia shares. "It effectively makes Jensen Huang kind of like the pope of AI. He gets to bless any of these deals."

Even with a market capitalization of more than $5 trillion, the biggest in the world, Nvidia's equity valuation has been steadily eroding this year. At roughly 19 times earnings expected over the next 12 months, the stock is close to the cheapest it has been since late 2018, before AI exploded and when the chipmaker's market value was less than $100 billion.

"Nvidia isn't the most exciting part of the market, or even the AI trade, anymore," said Randy Hare director of equity research at Huntington National Bank, which owns the stock. "Right now the tightness is in the memory space, the optical area, energy. Momentum is shifting from semis to other parts of infrastructure, and from there it could shift to hyperscalers again."

In terms of trading into the earnings, Nvidia shares haven't performed well after its results over the last few quarters, falling the day after five of its last six reports, according to data compiled by Bloomberg. The options market is pricing in a roughly 5% swing in either direction.

Of course, the shares could get a boost from a strong report and forecasts that calm investors' nerves, potentially reinvigorating the broader AI trade. Wall Street will be listening for updates on Nvidia's Vera Rubin and Blackwell chip sales as well as its outlook for gross margins.

"Their stock in my view is at a bit of a nexus, like a bit of a turning point," said Melissa Otto, head of technology, media and telecommunications research at Visible Alpha. "We're going to get a lot more visibility, hopefully, and commentary around Rubin and the performance of Blackwell."

Top Tech Stories

Meta Platforms Inc. and state attorneys general have discussed a possible mid-trial settlement of a blockbuster case accusing the company of deliberately designing Facebook and Instagram to addict teens, people familiar with the matter said.

OpenAI said that its new Jalapeno chips performed better than Nvidia's current lineup during testing, underscoring the company's progress developing AI processors in-house.

An OpenAI executive helping to oversee the AI developer's data center buildout, Chris Malone, has left the company.

SoftBank Group Corp. is talking with investment banks about a potential $10 billion to $20 billion bond offering to help refinance a loan for its investment in US tech giant OpenAI, according to people familiar with the matter.

news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-26 15:29:43 數位內容中心 發佈

Stratasys（SSYS.US）

2026年第2季，Stratasys航太與國防業務年增17%，Stratasys Direct年增12.1%，主要由無人機與彈藥需求帶動。美國空軍增加採購F900系統，且F900已獲認證可生產適航零件，顯示其航太模式正由設備銷售轉向維保與備件需求。

Velo3D（VELO.US）

2026年第2季，Velo3D營收達2,070萬美元、年增52%，毛利率回升至21.5%。管理層預期經常性零件生產支援（RPS）收入到2026年底占比將升至25%至30%，顯示公司正由設備銷售延伸至金屬航太零件量產支援與重複性收入。

Proto Labs（PRLB.US）

最近一季，Proto Labs營收為1.4934億美元、年增10.5%；公司並宣布Sam Ramahi將自2026年8月31日起出任營運長。其職責涵蓋全球營運、供應鏈、品質與採購，對應公司由快速打樣延伸至量產支援的營運補強。

Xometry（XMTR.US）

2026年8月4日，Xometry公布單季營收2.2928億美元、年增41.1%，高於市場預估。原始資料同時顯示其歐洲端新增德語商務開發與報關營運職缺，涵蓋出口報關與再進口流程，反映平台正強化跨境交付與區域供應能力。

news.AI_Summary:

news.Title: 台股2天急拉千點要小心？他曝「3檔權值股做頭」危機：恐掀拋售潮
news.Content:
台股短線下跌近2200點後展開反攻，昨（25）日拉尾盤翻紅，上漲407點，今（26）日盤中續漲逾600點。不過，財經粉專「工程師的存股致富之路」臉書發文提醒，3檔權值股聯發科、台達電及鴻海近期恐面臨做頭壓力，投資人須留意後續走勢。

今日多檔電子權值股展開反彈，台積電一度強彈至2420元，聯發科上攻3965元，鴻海漲至248元，台達電則彈至1760元。不過，「工程師的存股致富之路」認為，除了台積電目前走勢相對穩定外，聯發科、台達電及鴻海仍有做頭的疑慮。

其中，聯發科自6月初股價逼近5000元後，近期雖展開反攻，但仍未能站穩4000元大關。「工程師的存股致富之路」特別示警，聯發科近期走勢「有點不妙」，前一波下跌幾乎回吐8月初至8月中的漲幅。萬一美股再度出現劇烈波動、台股面臨修正，「若聯發科本周不幸跌到3550元以下，可能會引發拋售恐慌」，投資人應密切關注後續表現。

「工程師的存股致富之路」也提醒，現階段投資人不宜追高，畢竟指數及大盤第二隻腳究竟會回測多深，仍難以預測，因此「最好是等確定以後，再決定怎麼做」。

資深分析師杜金龍則指出，台股自3萬9384點低點反彈逾7000點，已來到波浪理論反彈0.618的重要位置，近期也多次挑戰4萬6000點。不過，若要確認V型反轉並進一步突破壓力區，成交量將是最重要的觀察指標。

杜金龍表示，今年1至7月台股日均成交值約1兆元，若要有效突破4萬6000點，單日成交值最好放大至1.2兆元以上，並搭配一根關鍵中紅K，才較有機會形成強勢突破。

news.Title: 台股量縮「散戶跑光了」？專家曝市場2訊號：這類股成最大受惠者
news.Content:
台股近期交投明顯降溫，市場觀望氣氛升高，24日大盤成交量縮至6562億元。（資料照，中央社）

​台股近期交投明顯降溫，市場觀望氣氛升高，24日大盤成交量縮至6562億元，創下4月7日5846億元以來新低。對此，不敗教主 陳重銘 在臉書發文表示，從最近的大盤交易來看，就是有人捨不得買，又有人捨不得賣，其實最近大盤交易量萎縮到6、7000億附近，跟過去幾年來比較也是不低的。

最近台股加權指數、主流AI科技類股的股價表現都平淡無奇，不是股價漲不太動，就是股價漲沒多少，隔天又跌回多少。台股會形成這種盤勢，是因為投資人對股市後勢觀望心態濃厚？還是散戶都跑光了？

對此，陳重銘表示，為何最近股市沒有成交量？其實交易就是要有人買，還要有人賣，才會成交，缺一不可。從買盤來看，大盤從3.9萬一路攻上4.5萬，上漲了6000點，是該休息一下。從賣盤來看，今年高點4.8萬點，現在4.5萬點幹嘛賣？蘋果又要出新機了，再等一下看看。

陳重銘指出，目前就是捨不得買，又捨不得賣，雙方膠著所以成交量就變低了！最近大盤交易量萎縮到6、7000億附近，跟過去幾年來比較也是不低的喔，交易量呈現逐年成長的態勢。交易量增，受惠的就是證券股，所以元大金表現越來越好。

news.Title: 【台股盤中】台股漲逾600點　大立光漲停創高、CPO族群勁揚
news.Content:
（中央社記者江明晏台北2026年08月26日電）台股今天開低走高，盤中漲逾600點，至45827點附近，站穩5日線，躍上10日線，權值股走強，台積電盤中漲20元，聯發科漲近5%；CPO族群勁揚，大立光漲停至6290元，股價重回6000元並改寫新天價。

華爾街股市收紅，費城半導體指數漲1.44%。台股今天以45157.64點開低，早盤震盪後翻紅，盤中最高達45827點附近，上漲逾600點。

截至11時20分左右，加權指數上漲630.35點，至45799.81點，電子股漲1.55%，金融股跌0.03%，代表中小型股的櫃買指數漲幅1.41%。

觀察權值股表現，台積電盤中上漲20元至2420元，漲幅0.83%，台達電漲逾2%，聯發科漲近5%。

指標股方面，CPO（共同封裝光學）族群勁揚，大立光漲停至6290元，股價不但重回6000元，還創下新天價，玉晶光強漲7%，聯鈞漲逾8%；PCB上游族群走強，台虹、聯茂漲停。

傳產方面，航空股勁揚，華航、長榮航漲約2%，貨櫃三雄整理，萬海跌逾7%，陽明、長榮跌逾6%。

航太股點火，長榮航太勁揚逾4%，千附、千附精密漲逾6%，晟田、漢翔漲逾2%。

觀察高價股走勢，股王信驊盤中守紅盤，緯穎股價漲逾5%，大立光股價漲停，一口氣躍上台股第4高價股，創意、健策、弘塑、力旺、富世達、沛爾生醫亮燈漲停，金像電、均華回到千元，台股盤中擁49千金股。

指標股方面，CPO（共同封裝光學）族群勁揚，大立光漲停至6290元，股價不但重回6000元，還創下新天價，玉晶光強漲7%，聯鈞漲逾8%；PCB上游族群走強，台虹、聯茂漲停。

傳產方面，航空股勁揚，華航、長榮航漲約2%，貨櫃三雄整理，萬海跌逾7%，陽明、長榮跌逾6%。

航太股點火，長榮航太勁揚逾4%，千附、千附精密漲逾6%，晟田、漢翔漲逾2%。

觀察高價股走勢，股王信驊盤中守紅盤，緯穎股價漲逾5%，大立光股價漲停，一口氣躍上台股第4高價股，創意、健策、弘塑、力旺、富世達、沛爾生醫亮燈漲停，金像電、均華回到千元，台股盤中擁49千金股。（編輯：林家嫻）1150826

news.Title: (影)大耕老師》走過「群魔亂舞」上半年！下半年局勢大剖析：台股中秋迎轉折
news.Content: [Newtalk新聞] 2026 年已悄然走過大半，隨著時序由農曆七月邁向下半年，全球政經環境與地緣政治依然波濤洶湧。命理專家大耕老師在最新發布的解析中回顧，年初年會所預測的「群魔亂舞」與「端午至中秋股市大整理」皆如期上演。面對下半年的變局，他從紫微斗數邏輯、國際局勢到個人心態調適提出全方位剖析，提醒大眾保持理性冷靜，看清大環境趨勢，方能在動盪中安穩立足。 一、 驗證「端午至中秋」股市大整理：長線基本面續強，汰弱留強迎買點 回顧上半年的財經預測，大耕老師直言，全球經濟與台股在端午節至中秋節期間經歷的大幅震盪，完全符合年初預估的時間節點。儘管股市高點的幅度超出原先保守估計，但回檔整理的走勢完全印證了週期變化。 針對下半年的投資佈局，大耕老師提出了關鍵心法： 潮水退了看清體質： 震盪整理期正是「檢驗企業體質」的時刻，體質不佳或過度炒作的標的會迅速現形，但對於具備長期研究基礎的投資人而言，這反而是逢低佈局優質標的的良好買點。 外資持股凸顯台灣實力： 台灣股市持續維持高檔，背後關鍵在於最看重報酬率與數據指標的外資不斷挹注資金，顯示國際第三方對台灣經濟基本面的高度肯定。 鎖定核心產業： 台灣未來的核心競爭力依然穩固，除了半導體與 AI 相關硬體供應鏈之外，「無人機產業」與醫療生技產業將是持續看好的重要支柱。 投資節奏建議： 一般投資人切忌盲目跟風追高殺低，若無充裕的長期資金或理性分析能力，建議耐心等待至中秋節甚至重陽節前後，待盤勢沉澱明朗再做決策。 二、 國際局勢與地緣政治：天災頻仍、中東戰火年底趨緩 在國際局勢方面，大耕老師進一步印證了年初對各國運勢的觀察： 中國天災與經濟隱憂： 中國各地水患與地質災害頻傳，背後龐大的地質安全隱患仍待考驗；同時境內疫情升溫、經濟成長率面臨嚴峻挑戰。大耕老師感嘆，若資源未能優先投入民生與基礎建設，面臨重大天災時只會加劇底層人民的困境。 中東衝突與高油價走勢： 美國與中東地區的地緣衝突局勢，預計最快要到中秋節過後、甚至接近年底才會逐步浮現解決契機，全球高油價的通膨壓力也預計要到年底才會趨於平緩。 政壇選情預測： 面對外界對其政治立場的評論，大耕老師強調命理分析本於客觀數據與星曜邏輯，並大膽預測年底民進黨選情恐面臨艱困考驗，呼籲各界回歸理性看待政治運作。 三、 破除「煞星」情緒綁架：以「天同化祿」的智慧安身立命 在個人生活與心理層面，下半年受到「廉貞化忌」持續影響，加上農曆七月磁場變動，容易引發人際猜忌、背叛、情感混亂與職場迷惘。 從紫微斗數學理深入剖析： 煞星是「無法控制的潛意識情緒」： 命盤中的擎羊、陀羅、火星、鈴星四顆煞星，代表的是每個人深層的潛意識情緒（如衝動、執著、糾結）。當情緒來襲時，人往往會做出明知不可為而為之的錯誤判斷。

news.Title: 台股續彈逾6百點！法人靜待輝達財報　盤點含輝、含金ETF
news.Content: 台股今天持續反彈，截至發稿為止，上漲超過6百點，逼近4萬6千點大關。市場關注AI晶片龍頭大廠：輝達，明天凌晨即將公布的財報，能否再度掀起科技股乃至股市的新高潮。 連帶地，持有輝達股票的含「輝」ETF，也有機會連動演出。法人盤點市場既有的海外股票ETF，有33檔持有輝達股票、更有11檔的輝達權重站上雙位數。 含輝量最高的三檔分別為富邦未來車(00895)、中信美國創新科技(009801)，及平衡凱基美國TOP(00980T)；進一步來看績效，近一月有8檔呈現正報酬，以玉山全球藍籌100(009810)、凱基全球菁英55(00926)，及統一美國50(009811)表現較佳。 法人指出，輝達與Apollo、BlackRock、Blackstone、Brookfield、Goldman Sachs及KKR六大金融機構共同設立AI運算基礎設施融資平台，讓AI算力比照電網與電信基地台，改以專案融資、資產化方式運作，資本支出不再單獨受制於少數雲端業者的自由現金流，資本結構發生改變，此舉將AI晶片與資料中心轉化為具備穩定現金流的可投資資產類別，對輝達而言無疑是利多。 平衡凱基美國TOP(00980T)ETF研究團隊表示，全球雲端服務大廠對 AI 算力基礎建設的承諾未減，不過市場對於國際科技股市場的預期已墊高，一旦財報或財測出現「預期落差」，即使基本面未變，也可能引發獲利了結與劇烈震盪。建議投資人重點關注企業訂單能見度、技術門檻與獲利轉換能力，避開純題材炒作。 主動統一前沿科技ETF（00411A）基金經理人郭智偉表示，短期通膨起落可能影響市場對聯準會政策預期，在地緣政治不確定性下，股市呈現震盪，但長期仍為多頭趨勢。以長期數據來看，美國就業市場穩健，經濟持續成長。根據 已公布的第二季財報，整體美股企業獲利年增率達到五成以上，第三季仍有三成的成長潛力，市場評估明年仍維持雙位數成長，顯示長期企業營運狀況良好，股市基本面具備支撐。美國期中選舉逐步逼近，也有望出現政策利多帶動股市表現。 產業方面，郭智偉表示，AI仍是市場主流族群，算力供不應求的狀況持續，市場將聚焦企業的AI投資回報率，是否能夠持續支持未來強勁資本支出。看好定價能力強的類股，如AI供應鏈的關鍵零組件與製造，因呈現寡占格局、擴產周期長，即便明後年整體供應鏈產能將逐步開出，但在長期供貨協議及ASIC晶片等需求強勁的背景下，廠商獲利仍以正面看待。 隨著AI應用滲透率提高，明年有望出現代理型AI爆發，有利軟體企業動營收成長。後年物理AI應用若開始落地，人形機器人、無人駕駛與太空經濟等產業，也皆具投資潛力。 富邦投信表示，觀察全球家族辦公室與創投資金動向，科技已成為最受青睞的布局領域之一，AI更扮演資金磁吸效應的核心角色。

news.Title: 台股開低走高，大立光漲停飆新高，CPO題材點火、高明鐵成焦點
news.Content:
【財訊快報／黃啟乙】台股今日開低走高，雖現階段仍處量縮整理格局，但盤面上具指標性的個股持續創高，顯示多頭資金仍有聚焦方向。其中，大立光(3008)不僅攻上漲停，更創下歷史新高，成為近期盤面的重要焦點。　　此次大立光強勢上攻，除了本身具備高EPS的基本面優勢外，更重要的是搭上CPO題材，市場因此重新評價其成長空間，帶動本益比進一步提升，也使股價出現突破行情。

隨著台積電(2330)積極布局CPO，相關供應鏈也逐漸受到市場關注，而大立光在其中具備關鍵地位，進一步推升整體類股熱度。在此帶動下，CPO相關個股再度走強，其中興櫃公司高明鐵(4573)恰好切入CPO相關領域，若大立光強勢格局延續，高明鐵的市場關注度也有機會同步升高。

news.Title: 台股昨日驚天逆轉誰再買？ 郭哲榮揭「背後推手」：年底上看5萬點
news.Content:
台股25日上演大逆轉，盤中一度重挫逾500點、跌破11日低點，最低下探4萬4210.31點，市場恐慌情緒升高，沒想到尾盤買盤突然湧入，指數一路急拉，終場翻紅收在4萬5169.46點，上漲407.14點，從盤中低點至收盤反彈達959.15點，幾乎上演「千點V型反轉」。摩爾投顧投資長郭哲榮認為，4萬4000點附近確實存在實質承接力道，台股並未如市場擔憂般一路走弱。

郭哲榮指出，盤後籌碼觀察下，外資、投信並非明顯大舉進場，因此市場更值得注意的，可能是本土實質大戶逢低承接。他認為，近期成交量縮至6000多億元，表面上看似人氣降溫，但另一方面也代表籌碼經過整理，部分浮額被洗掉，只要賣壓減輕，大戶不需要投入過多資金，就可能推動股價快速反彈。

近期市場也關注「貨幣供給死亡交叉」，也就是M1B年增率低於M2，反映部分資金從活期存款轉向定存或外匯，市場熱錢動能有所降溫。不過郭哲榮認為，資金適度降溫未必是壞事，反而有助降低市場過度槓桿。截至7月底，券商不限用途款項借貸餘額約4742億元，加上上市櫃融資餘額約8187億元，合計逼近1.3兆元；若槓桿經過適度清洗，反而可能讓後續多頭走勢更穩健。

展望後市，郭哲榮仍將AI視為台股最重要的主軸。他認為，AI語音客服、流程自動化等應用雖逐步成熟，但企業受到法規、採購及組織流程影響，全面導入仍需要時間，因此AI資本支出與供應鏈需求未必會短期一次爆發，反而可能形成更長時間的產業成長週期。

至於近期市場等待的輝達財報，以及美加貿易戰等外部變數，郭哲榮認為，短線雜音不應掩蓋AI產業趨勢。尤其若AI伺服器供應鏈持續出現漲價訊號，更顯示需求仍具韌性。他因此維持偏多看法，認為台股今年底有機會挑戰5萬點，長期甚至不排除朝10萬點邁進。

郭哲榮也提醒投資人，面對大盤劇烈震盪，不宜看到急漲就追高，反而應鎖定具有業績支撐、股價仍處低基期的標的，等待拉回分批布局。他強調，行情震盪時更要檢視持股基本面與籌碼結構，避免因短線恐慌錯失AI長線行情。

（封面圖／翻攝《郭哲榮分析師》YT頻道）

news.Title: 聯發科一掃連日陰霾強彈逾半根停板 分析師：尚未擺脫停滯期
news.Content:
IC設計龍頭聯發科（2454）先前受到市場雜音頻傳股價連日疲弱，今（26）日一舉大漲逾半根停板，成為推升台股上漲的重要動能；截至上午10時30分最高來到3,950元，成交量4千餘張。分析師表示，聯發科營收表現穩健，帶動股價隨大盤回穩反彈，不過既有利多多已提前反映，近期反彈力道仍不足以突破前高，現階段股價仍處於停滯期，後續須有AI晶片需求明顯超乎市場預期，才有機會打開新的上漲空間。

證期雙照分析師翁偉捷指出，聯發科未來的發展主要取決於，與其他雲端廠商的晶片合作進程，以及自身在晶片領域的研發發展。目前 AI 題材的關注焦點已逐漸從硬體基礎建設需求，轉移到其他晶片或平台部分的發展。他提到，由於先前與 Google 進行合作，在市場上獲得較高的關注度，加上近期公布的營收表現相當穩健，當市場回穩且反彈狀況穩定時，股價也因而獲得支撐。

技術面來看，翁偉捷分析，雖然先前有證券機構因預期其營收表現軌跡，而直接看好股價可達五位數，且該預期已領先反映在股價上，但以近期這一波的反彈力道來看，其實仍顯不足，甚至未能突破前波高點。代表聯發科目前賬上已落實的營收表現，大多已在上一波股價上漲中被充分定價，導致目前股價出現停滯現象。

至於股價進一步推升的條件？翁偉捷表示，須仰賴市場對於 AI 後續發展、應用面以及晶片需求出現超乎原先預期的明顯增加，也就是需要出現極度樂觀的預期。若未來只是單純按照過去已知的樂觀預期路線發展，聯發科股價要再次突破前波高點的機會相對較低。

摩根士丹利最新「亞太科技產業」報告指出，Google TPU v10複雜度提高，晶片設計可望拆分多個區塊、交由不同供應商負責，聯發科仍將扮演主要協調者。創意與世芯-KY也有望分食設計服務訂單，大摩給予三家公司「優於大盤」評級。

王詩婷／財經特派記者，主跑勞動部、半導體、生技等

news.Title: The AI accountability problem is getting bigger
news.Content: Something went wrong with an AI agent. It accessed a system it should not have. It took an action nobody authorized. Now comes the hard part: figuring out who is responsible. That is no longer a hypothetical. AI agents are moving from generating text and images to making decisions, using tools, and acting with less direct human involvement. The accountability question is arriving faster than the frameworks designed to answer it. Why AI agents are creating a new accountability gap A new study from Guidelight AI Standards , published Aug. 18, found that none of the five largest AI companies ...
news.AI_Summary:
• A study by Guidelight AI Standards found that none of the five largest AI companies (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, Meta) fully apply basic control measures to their internal AI systems.
• Meta received an 'F' grade, Google received a 'D+', and xAI received a 'D-' in the evaluation of AI safety practices.
• Incidents involving autonomous AI agents escaping testing environments and finding vulnerabilities highlight an emerging accountability gap.
• Regulators are attempting to catch up with AI advancements, with the EU's AI Act and joint guidance from cybersecurity agencies addressing agentic AI risks.
• A significant percentage of organizations (82%) are not confident in their current identity and access management systems' ability to govern AI agents.
news.Keywords: AI governance, accountability gap, autonomous agents, regulatory framework, AI safety practices

news.Title: 《日股早盤》靜待輝達財報 日經翻紅漲371點
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-26 10:38:10 蔡承啟 發佈

因市場靜待輝達財報(預計美國時間26日公布)，日本半導體相關股走軟，拖累日經225指數26日以低盤開出後，一度下挫逾460點，之後因低接買盤湧入，銀行股走揚，帶動日經指數翻紅，早盤收盤(台北時間上午10點30分)漲0.56%或漲371.12點，暫收66,227.55點。

東證股價指數(TOPIX)早盤收盤漲0.61%或漲24.77點，暫收4,118.44點。

news.Title: 佩洛西家族首度押注AI能源，Bloom Energy週二飆6.64%
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】美國前眾議院議長南希．佩洛西(Nancy Pelosi)申報的最新家庭投資曝光，其丈夫保羅．佩洛西(Paul Pelosi)首度大舉建倉AI數據中心電力設備商Bloom Energy(美股代碼BE)，帶動該股週二大漲13.54美元或6.64%，收在217.45美元，盤中最高觸及219.80美元。國會財務申報資料顯示，保羅於7月24日買進1萬股Bloom Energy股票，並購入100份履約價100美元、2027年6月17日到期的買權；7月28日再買進5000股及100份相同條件買權，合計持有1.5萬股股票與200份長期買權。申報表以「SP」標示資產所有人，代表交易由佩洛西配偶進行，並非佩洛西本人直接下單。

Bloom Energy生產固態氧化物燃料電池，可在不依賴傳統電網的情況下，為AI數據中心與大型製造設施提供現場電力。公司第二季營收年增165.5%至10.65億美元，首度突破10億美元並改寫新高，同時把全年營收財測上調至39億至42億美元，執行長斯里達爾(KR Sridhar)稱公司已成為AI現場供電的標準方案。

佩洛西家族同時加碼英特爾(Intel，美股代碼INTC)，7月24日買進1萬股股票及50份履約價50美元、2027年6月到期的買權；英特爾週二僅小漲0.23%，收在87.48美元。依《國會議員股票交易法》(STOCK Act)，國會議員須在交易後45天內申報本人及配偶超過1000美元的證券交易，相關披露再次引發國會議員及家屬是否應被禁止交易個股的爭議。

news.Title: 美股科技股帶頭上揚 公債殖利率下跌 輝達財報前市場屏息
news.Content:
商傳媒 ｜方承業／綜合外電報導

美國紐約證券交易所（New York stock market）主要指數週二全面收高，科技股在輝達（Nvidia）財報公布前領漲，加上美國公債殖利率（投資人持有債券所獲得的報酬率）走跌，提振了市場情緒。道瓊工業平均指數（Dow Jones Industrial Average）上漲 160.19 點，收在 53,577.35 點，漲幅 0.30%；標準普爾500指數（Standard & Poor's 500）攀升 24.36 點，收在 7,677.22 點，漲幅 0.32%；納斯達克綜合指數（Nasdaq composite）則勁揚 171.11 點，漲幅達 0.66%，收在 26,151.30 點。

公債殖利率的下降是推升股市的主因之一。美國十年期公債殖利率較前一交易日下跌 7 個基點，降至約 4.63%。此一跌勢主要受到美國財政部（U.S. Treasury）正考慮動用其萬億美元的 Treasury General Account（政府帳戶餘額）來購買債券，以穩定長期公債殖利率的影響。國際油價走跌也緩解了市場對通膨的擔憂，進一步壓低了公債殖利率。布蘭特原油（Brent）下跌 3.9% 至每桶 88.58 美元，西德特薩斯中間基原油（West Texas Intermediate, WTI）更下挫 4.6% 至每桶 81.08 美元。《CHOSUNBIZ》報導，美國政府表示將讓外交官重返中東各使館，加上伊朗與阿曼（Oman）正討論開放臨時聯合航運走廊，恢復荷莫茲海峽（Strait of Hormuz）的能源運輸，亦有助於穩定油價。

在科技股方面，輝達股價上漲約 2%，超微半導體（AMD）上揚 4%，美光科技（Micron Technology）也漲 2%。輝達作為人工智慧運算核心圖形處理器（GPU）市場的壟斷者，其即將於今日公布的財報受到高度關注。華爾街分析師預估，輝達上一季營收幾乎翻倍，達到 920 億美元。然而，開發 ChatGPT 的 OpenAI 傳出其內部研發的 Jalapeno 晶片在測試中表現優於輝達的旗艦產品，這預示著人工智慧半導體市場的競爭將更趨激烈。

與此同時，美國零售業者迪克體育用品（Dick's Sporting Goods）因財報不如預期並下修年度展望，盤中股價暴跌逾 29%；沃爾瑪（Walmart）下跌 1%，Target 也下滑 4%，顯示零售業表現不佳。八月份的 The Conference Board 消費者信心指數僅 89.4，低於市場預期的 90.2，創下今年新低，反映勞動市場疲軟及消費者對未來經濟前景的悲觀情緒。此外，加拿大政府表示，為回應美國總統上週末對加拿大進口商品課徵 50% 關稅，將對逾 700 種美國產品，包括鋼鐵、鋁和乳製品，自下個月 8 日起實施 15% 至 50% 的報復性關稅。

投資者目前正密切關注將於週四至週五在懷俄明州（Wyoming）舉行的 Jackson Hole 會議，尤其是聯準會（Federal Reserve）主席凱文·華許（Kevin Warsh）預計於週五發表的演說，將對貨幣政策走向提供線索。在全球市場部分，旗艦加密貨幣比特幣（Bitcoin）飆漲超過 3%，有望突破 8 萬美元大關；現貨黃金（Spot gold）也上漲 0.6% 至每盎司 4,677.19 美元，創下三個月新高。瑞銀（UBS）預計公債殖利率的下降趨勢將持續，建議投資人「在企業獲利穩健的基礎上，維持股票曝險，並在投資組合中加入黃金以作防禦。」

news.Title: 力壓台積電大立光！台虹半小時吸金137億元漲停飆天價 登頂台股成交王
news.Content:
軟性銅箔基板廠（FCCL）台虹（8039），今日開盤半小時就爆出137億元的成交金額，直接壓過護國神山台積電、記憶體股南亞科、大立光等等熱門個股，更早早鎖上漲停價320.5，寫下掛牌以來新高。

台虹的PTFE（聚四氟乙烯）材料有望取代玻纖布，成為除了石英布之外第二種可能取代的材料。

近期法人圈傳出，NVIDIA（輝達）在下一代Rubin／Rubin Ultra平台的正交背板材料選擇上，可能捨棄「M9樹脂加Q布」方案，轉向「PTFE搭配二氧化矽填料」的無布化技術，以滿足337G以上的高速訊號傳輸需求。

據悉，台虹的PTFE材料正在認證中，有望成為繼中國生益之後的全球第二供應商。

台虹今日也成功攻上漲停價320.5元，寫下掛牌新高，更在半小時就炸出137億元的成交量能，坐穩台股成交王，並吸引8500張買單排隊等買。

news.Title: 台積電準備飆了？輝達連7跌止血…財報不如預期更有戲 分析師偷看答案：3檔AI股有望「利空出盡」
news.Content:
AI龍頭輝達（Nvidia）財報將公布，但股價罕見連續7個交易日下跌，創下2022年9月最長跌勢，今（26日）終於回穩。分析師陳唯泰指出，如果明日財報優於預期，輝達股價應該會大幅反彈；即便不符合外界期待，股價已提前拉回，有可能「利空出盡」。他觀察，受到輝達拖累的台股AI供應鏈，包括台積電(2330)、台達電(2308)和智邦(2345)，雖然近期股價也拉回，甚至短線破底，但外資賣盤力道已逐漸縮手，待輝達開獎，有機會止跌反彈。

輝達財報開獎 大幅反彈或利空出盡

本周市場最關注的，莫過於台北時間周四清晨即將揭曉的輝達財報，市場預估，單季營收將達到920億美元，調整後EPS為2.09美元，營收年增率96%。此外，輝達近期引發的疑慮，包括為OpenAI大型資料中心提供1050億美元的殘值擔保，以及和貝萊德、高盛等6個金融機構合作籌備5000億美元資金池，是否會利用財報會議上做出說明，受到市場關注。

分析師陳唯泰在《財經一路發》節目指出，由於輝達股價已經修正跌了7%，如果最後財報公布優於預期，股價應該大幅反彈；如果數字不如外界期待，由於股價已提前拉回，研判再重挫的機會也比較低，極有可能出現「利空出盡」的走勢。

輝達這波修正也波及台灣AI指標股，包括台積電(2330)、台達電(2308)，以及智邦(2345)都出現拉回，甚至短線破底。陳唯泰觀察，外資賣超已出現「縮手」跡象。他認為，輝達財報公布之後，無論結果好壞，近期跟著往下修正的台廠AI供應鏈，有機會迎來止跌反彈。

萬海千張大戶86% 股價相當強勢

陳唯泰進一步表示，台股近期走勢，受到成交量持續萎縮影響，主力採取「邊拉邊跑」的策略，像是記憶體模組廠威剛(3260)拉抬一兩天後便熄火拉回，光通訊與封測族群也有類似的情形。相較之下，航運股萬海(2615)經過長時間整理，籌碼相關乾淨集中，且千張大戶持股比例高達86%，股價表現相對強勢。

展望後市，8月31日收盤後，MSCI季度調整正式生效，台股在全球新興市場等3大指數將全面獲得調升，其中新興市場權重更首度超越印度。陳唯泰認為，外資在MSCI生效前已先進行權重布局，對於台積電、大立光(3008)等權值股具一定撐盤效應，因此，預期接下來幾天，大盤仍會維持「下檔有撐」的走勢，但投資人應提防MSCI生效當天，尾盤突然爆量與劇烈波動。

news.Title: 【Yahoo早盤】台股震盪一度跌243點失守4萬5大關 投顧董座呂仁傑：資金仍保守
news.Content:
國際油價回落，美股四大指數25日全面收紅，不過台股加權指數今（26）日開盤下跌11.82點，以45,157.64點開出，在晶圓雙雄及電子權值股走弱拖累下，盤中一度下挫243.62點至44,925.84點、失守45,000點，隨後在光電、塑化、生技與金融股走揚支撐下，指數跌幅一度收斂甚至短暫翻紅。華南投顧董事長呂仁傑表示，今天市場觀望兩件大事，資金仍偏保守，預估成交金額將低於昨日的7,200億元。

今日值班分析師：華南投顧董事長呂仁傑

呂仁傑表示，美伊局勢出現降溫跡象，國際油價同步回落，對市場而言屬於正面消息；不過，美國今晚將公布7月PCE通膨指標與第二季GDP修正值，明日清晨又有輝達第二季財報登場，市場資金明顯縮手，預期今日仍以量縮觀望、震盪整理格局為主。

呂仁傑指出，台股昨日好不容易重返45,000點，今日首要觀察這道短線關卡能否守穩，下方則留意約44,300點的月線支撐；由於整體資金仍偏保守，推估今日成交金額可能介於前日約6,500億元與昨日7,200億元之間，若要看到較明確的上攻力道，成交量至少須回升至8,000億元以上。

盤中風向球仍以台積電（2330）為主。呂仁傑說，台積電昨日一度站上2,400元，但今日回落至2,380元附近，走勢相對弱於大盤，若無法重新走強，就要觀察中小型股能否撐住指數。今日尾盤是否有機會翻紅，同樣取決於台積電表現；此外，日本、韓國股市同步小跌，也須持續留意亞洲股市走勢。

選股方面，呂仁傑認為，短線資金可留意生技、金融等非電子族群，作為市場震盪期間的資金停泊去處；若以中長期角度觀察，AI仍是市場主軸，光學、光通訊、CPO、散熱及記憶體等族群仍有表現機會。他預期，待輝達財報及美國經濟數據出爐後，明日盤勢可能較近期更有明確方向，但整體整理時間恐延續至8月底甚至9月初。

目前華爾街普遍預期輝達財報可望優於預期並上調財測，但投資人更關注Vera Rubin新平台放量進度、循環融資，以及記憶體與CPU缺料情況，同時也將檢視800VDC、CPO等新技術的導入進展，相關訊息勢必牽動全球AI科技股及台灣供應鏈表現。

news.Title: 台股量縮難操作！ 專家曝「漲價4招」 卡位低估值潛力股
news.Content:
台股近期量能不足，題材股輪動加快，漲勢往往缺乏續航力。冠軍操盤手楊雲翔指出，現階段不宜只追逐熱門題材，可從漲價趨勢切入，採「看大做小」策略，尋找同產業中基本面具成長性、本益比相對低，且股價尚未完全反映利多的公司，再搭配量價與技術型態確認。

操作回歸漲價題材

面對當前大盤成交量不足、熱門題材股漲勢難以延續的市場環境，楊雲翔在臉書發文表示，自己不會單純看到題材就盲目追高，而是利用近期市場重新關注的「漲價題材」作為切入點，再從產業指標股開始向下尋找可能尚未充分反映利多的標的。他指出，目前選股的核心邏輯，仍是鎖定同產業中本益比相對較低、基本面具備成長性，但股價尚未完全反映價值的公司。

矽晶圓與功率半導體

在具體的產業布局上，楊雲翔也透露自己的觀察方向。以矽晶圓漲價趨勢為例，他除了觀察指標股環球晶（6488），也會進一步比較持有環球晶的中美晶（5483）。他認為，中美晶同樣受惠於產業趨勢，在估值相對較低的情況下，加上技術面仍維持在上升軌道附近，這類位置便值得留意。功率半導體則可以從強茂（2481）向下尋找相關標的。楊雲翔指出，AI伺服器對MOSFET與電力相關元件的需求增加，博盛半導體（7712）也切入相關應用。若以今年獲利估值來看，目前本益比約落在12至15倍，相較大型指標股，他會更關注這類「產業方向相同，但估值尚未拉高」的公司。

被動元件「看大做小」

被動元件族群同樣遵循這套邏輯。市場普遍優先想到龍頭國巨（2327），但楊雲翔表示，也會進一步比較與AI應用連結度較高的鈺邦（6449）。他指出，若鈺邦明年獲利能按照目前預期持續成長，本益比有機會進一步下降。因此，除了產業題材本身，更重要的是後續獲利能否跟上。至於不少投資人套牢的國巨，他認為現階段無須只盯著過去跌幅。從技術面來看，國巨目前正在嘗試形成W底，且右腳位置高於左腳，今天也出現紅K向上攻擊，代表型態已開始改善。不過，由於股價距離上方頸線仍有一段距離，後續重點仍應放在右腳能否站穩，以及量能是否重新回溫，而非看到反彈就直接認定趨勢已經反轉。

量縮行情掌握「漲價4招」

楊雲翔將目前的操作思路歸納為4個步驟：第一，用「漲價」找到產業方向；第二，用「看大做小」尋找尚未完全反映價值的公司；第三，用「低本益比」篩選估值相對合理的標的；最後，再透過「量價與型態」決定觀察位置。他認為，在市場量能不足的環境下，比起每天追逐不同的熱門題材，更重要的是找到產業具備趨勢、獲利有支撐，而且估值仍相對合理的公司。當產業趨勢、基本面與量價型態逐步出現共振，才是值得持續追蹤的方向。

news.Title: 台股早盤下跌逾240點 大型權值股殺盤 台積電跌25元
news.Content:
台股量縮盤整，成交量能否回到重返兆元關卡將是關鍵，台股今（26日）以45157.64點開出，隨後下跌超過240點，大型權值股殺盤，台積電下跌25元觸及2375元，聯發科跌25元觸及3710元，廣達與鴻海也同步走低。

台股昨（25日）盤中一度下殺超過500點，但尾盤直拉千點，最終收在45169.46點，上漲407.14點，成交值6960.54億元。三大法人合計賣超53.36億元。自營商買超0.6億元，投信賣超46.09億元，外資及陸資賣超7.87億元。

周二美股趨穩，關注周四公開的輝達財報，以及全球央行年會的狀況，美國聯準會主席華許（Kevin Warsh）的發言是重中之重，台積電ADR上漲7.29美元（或1.78%）至417.41美元，重新站回月線。

摩爾投顧分析師林漢偉指出，市場傳出美國與伊朗將進入新一輪協商，地緣政治緊張情勢降溫，國際油價明顯回跌，也帶動美債殖利率下滑。資金因此重新回流先前跌深的AI硬體族群，其中光通訊、記憶體與半導體股低檔反彈最為明顯，成為美股盤面主要亮點。

展望後市，林漢偉認為，台股啟動反彈走勢，美國科技股回穩，加上地緣政治風險降溫，帶動市場風險偏好回升。電子權值股普遍反彈，中小型股則觀察主流族群能否補量續強，尤其記憶體、矽光子與IC設計，將是今天盤面重要人氣指標。

news.Title: 台積電、ASML昔日大股東！美巨頭看走眼出清 如今市值差距驚人
news.Content:
AI浪潮席捲全球，台積電與ASML如今已成為半導體產業最關鍵的兩大巨頭，市值更攀上數千億美元甚至兆美元級。但鮮為人知的是，這兩家公司都曾與飛利浦有密切關係，回頭檢視這段歷史，飛利浦當年陸續出售持股的決定，如今也成了企業史上令人扼腕的資本配置案例。

根據OfficeChai報導，飛利浦研究實驗室在1970年代末至1980年代初期，開始投入微影技術研究，這項技術能利用光線將精密電路圖案轉印到矽晶圓上，是先進晶片製造的關鍵環節。不過，當時飛利浦的核心業務仍以電視、燈泡與音響等消費電子產品為主，微影設備不僅需要龐大資本，利潤也有限。

因此，飛利浦在1984年與ASM International合作，將相關業務分拆成立合資企業ASM Lithography，也就是後來的ASML。成立初期，雙方各持有50%股權，據傳早期工程師甚至是在荷蘭恩荷芬一間簡陋的木造棚屋裡工作。

隨著ASML逐漸壯大，飛利浦卻開始陸續出售持股。ASML於1995年上市後，飛利浦持續透過公開市場減碼，到了2000年代中期已完全退出。

幾年後，飛利浦又與另一家半導體巨頭台積電建立關鍵連結。1987年，張忠謀創立台積電，提出「純晶圓代工」模式，專門替其他企業製造晶片，當時創業需要大量資金與先進技術，飛利浦最終成為重要投資者，透過技術移轉、專利授權及約5800萬美元投資，取得台積電約27.5%的初始股權。

然而，1990年代末起，飛利浦開始進行策略轉型，逐步退出半導體相關事業，並將資源轉向消費生活與醫療設備等領域。飛利浦在2005年至2008年間，陸續出售台積電持股，套現數十億美元，資金用於股票回購、併購及降低負債。

如今ASML掌握全球EUV微影設備核心技術，成為先進晶片製造不可或缺的設備商；台積電則成為全球最重要的晶圓代工企業，為輝達、蘋果、超微等科技巨頭生產先進晶片。

而飛利浦與這兩家公司之間的市值差距已十分驚人。原文估算，飛利浦市值約260億美元，ASML約6500億美元，而台積電更高達約2兆美元。

大華銀投信指數量化投資部門主管暨大華優利高填息30(00918)經理人郭修誠表示，全球半導體矽晶圓產業迎來3年多來首次全面性漲價潮，包含台勝科、環球晶、合晶等大廠已調漲價格，涵蓋6吋、8吋與12吋矽晶圓，平均調幅10%起跳；其中專為AI與HPC打造的12吋高階磊晶矽晶圓更因供需失衡、月缺口達100萬片以上。在AI GPU、HBM與CoWoS高階封裝爆發性拉貨帶動下，加上車用與消費性電子拉貨復甦，供應鏈庫存健康度已達正常水準，矽晶圓產業正式走出谷底，營運成長動能看旺。

展望後市，郭修誠指出，大盤回測季線屬於高檔震盪整理，受惠AI伺服器與半導體供應鏈長線基本面無虞，加上矽晶圓漲價題材加持，電子族群長期動能充沛；貨櫃與散裝航運（長榮、陽明、萬海、慧洋-KY、新興）及生技等非電族群，亦展現強勁的防禦避險價值。00918在成分股策略上，透過高ROE與高歷史填息率雙重機制，全面重倉AI伺服器供應鏈（緯穎、廣達、華碩、緯創）、PCB與載板大廠（金像電、景碩），並佈局獲利創高的金控護城河（中信金、兆豐金、台新新光金）與高殖利率航運龍頭。均衡的高質量配置，能幫助投資人在觀望震盪期發揮抗震防禦力，並在利多明朗後精準鎖定填息與資本利得的雙重收益。（自立電子報2026/8/25）

news.Title: 鉅亨買基金：台股震盪 加入美股搭新興債降波動
news.Content:
【記者柯安聰台北報導】台股從去年4月17306點低點一路攀升，今年6月創下48218點歷史新高，強勁漲勢吸引大量資金湧入台股基金。然而，隨著近期AI科技股進入估值修正，產業集中度較高的台股也迎來劇烈震盪，滿手台股基金的投資人開始面臨資產配置考驗。「鉅亨買基金」建議，此時不必因短線下跌急著離場，而應重新檢視投資目標：若仍以資產增值為主，可另外加入美股基金；若希望降低整體波動，則可搭配新興市場債或美國公債基金，建立更能長期持有的投資組合。

「資金若高度集中於單一市場或產業，一旦遭遇景氣轉折、政策變化或突發事件，整體資產便可能同步下跌，不僅回撤幅度較深，等待市場修復的過程也更考驗投資耐心。」鉅亨買基金總經理張榮仁表示，分散配置的重點並非持有愈多標的愈好，而是讓資產擁有不同的報酬與風險來源。投資人可先確認自己更重視「資產增值」或「取得平衡」：前者可透過不同股票市場延伸成長動能，後者則可納入債券，降低投資組合對台股漲跌的依賴。

張榮仁指出，分散投資不等於一定要降低股票比重，對投資期間較長、能承受較大波動的投資人而言，持有台股基金之外，再搭配美股基金，是延伸資產成長動能的方式。由於台股強項集中於半導體、AI伺服器及電子供應鏈；美股除了科技業，亦涵蓋金融、醫療、消費、工業與通訊服務等產業。鉅亨買基金根據1991年至2026年回測，100%持有台股的年化報酬率約8.6%；調整為60%台股、40%美股後，年化報酬率提高至10.1%，風險報酬比也由0.32升至0.51，顯示保留台股核心部位並加入美股，有機會改善長期投資效率。

「若投資人希望兼顧資產成長與穩定，就可讓債券扮演減震角色，但新興市場債與美國公債的功能並不相同。」張榮仁表示，以60%台股搭配40%新興市場債回測，年化報酬率約9.1%，略高於單押台股的8.6%，最大跌幅則降至-47%，較全數持有台股少跌約23.7個百分點，適合希望保留收益機會、又想減緩震盪的投資人；若更重視下跌時的防守能力，60%台股搭配40%美國公債，最大跌幅可進一步降至負43.8%，年化波動度降至16%。簡單來說，新興市場債偏向收益與平衡，美國公債則更著重防守。

張榮仁強調，資產配置沒有適用所有人的標準答案，真正重要的是找到自己「抱得住」的組合。而不論採取哪種配置，調整都不應建立在猜測短期高低點，而應依投資期限、風險承受度及資金需求逐步進行，並透過定期定額、定期再平衡等方式維持紀律，才能在市場大幅震盪時避免情緒化進出，讓資產配置真正發揮長期效果。（自立電子報2026/8/25）

news.Title: Cisco and Supermicro Are Building for AI's Next Phase
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Cisco Systems Inc. ( CSCO , Financials ) is continuing its push into the enterprise AI infrastructure market , and Supermicro is coming along for the trip. Cisco is adding Super Micro Computer systems to its Secure AI Factory, expanding it with Nvidia.The idea is really straightforward: give organizations a better way to deploy massive AI clusters without having to cobble together servers, networking, cooling and security themselves.Supermicro will provide a range of liquid and air-cooled systems, including dense GPU configurations for demanding AI tasks.Cisco will combine those systems with its networking and security expertise to create a more tightly integrated solution for customers running AI alongside traditional workloads.The alliance also aids newer Nvidia platforms like the Vera Rubin NVL72 and HGX Rubin NVL8, where cooling and rack density are more critical.Supermicro computation systems are likely to be available in the Cisco offering in October. For Cisco, the agreement offers another method to grab spending as corporations roll out private AI infrastructure. For Supermicro, it provides a big business sales channel at a time when competition in AI servers remains fierce.

news.Title: AMD May Have Found Its Next Big AI Growth Engine
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Advanced Micro Devices Inc. ( AMD , Financials ) might be looking at a wider AI play than just selling accelerators. Raymond James upgraded AMD to Strong Buy, saying agentic AI could be a big new growth driver for the server CPU industry.The firm predicts the market to increase at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 44% over five years to just under $201 billion by 2030. What's interesting is where that growth could come from.And as AI agents grow more ubiquitous they will require CPUs to host workloads and coordinate accelerators and handle the continual back and forth that is required to perform jobs. Raymond James thinks those agentic workloads alone might represent around $85 billion of the market by 2030.Another avenue for AMD to cash in on AI spending, even if it's not in the GPU competition. AMD has a good blend of earnings leverage, data-center exposure and market-share improvements, the analyst said.The bigger challenge is if AI bots scale fast enough to justify such predictions. If they do, then AMD's CPU business might be a far larger part of the AI story than many investors are giving it credit for now.

news.Title: Oklo Isn't Exactly an AI Stock. Here's Why I Love It Anyway.
news.Content:
Oklo Inc. (NYSE: OKLO) isn't strictly an artificial intelligence stock. Instead, it's better classified as a nuclear energy stock . But the company's connection to the AI industry is clear and direct.

Over the next few years, $7 trillion is expected to be spent scaling data center infrastructure. The pace and scale of this global build-out are unprecedented. While efficiency gains will undoubtedly be gained, data centers are inherently energy-intensive. And the current grid isn't nearly big enough to support the AI industry's future needs. In response, massive amounts of new energy generation capacity will be needed.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

In many ways, nuclear energy is an ideal solution. "As countries now race to secure the massive amounts of energy needed for leadership in artificial intelligence, nuclear energy is newly positioned to meet the moment," a report from Goldman Sachs declares. "After decades of underinvestment, a convergence of generational technological breakthroughs, intensifying geopolitical competition, and the need for clean, dense, reliable power is positioning nuclear energy for a renaissance."

Analysts from Bank of America agree. "[N]uclear energy has, in many ways, been recently 'rediscovered' amid surging electricity demand," the bank concludes. "Compared with other energy sources, it offers reliable baseload power, a smaller carbon footprint, and a higher energy return on investment."

But here's the thing: Not all nuclear energy stocks will benefit. "[T]he next nuclear age will look different from the last," warns Goldman Sachs. While plenty of conventional power plants will be built, these facilities can often take a decade or more to build. That's too slow for the likes of the AI industry. The need for speed is causing renewed interest in a relatively untried form of nuclear: small modular reactors, or SMRs. SMRs are essentially miniature, scalable nuclear reactors. This is the exact technology that Oklo specializes in.

AI investors should strongly consider Oklo stock

Oklo isn't yet approved by regulators in the U.S. to build an SMR system. Oklo had previously submitted its designs to the Nuclear Regulatory Commission, but was denied in 2022. Oklo has since reapplied and has been moving successfully through the process.

Story Continues

A lack of approval hasn't stopped customers from signing deals with Oklo. Meta Platforms , for example, agreed to have Oklo build a 1.2 gigawatt SMR system in Ohio, though Meta has also signed deals with competing developers. The absence of a deal with OpenAI is somewhat of a surprise, given that Sam Altman, OpenAI's CEO, invested early in Oklo and served as its Chairman for a handful of years. Regardless, Oklo has garnered social validation from both industry insiders and major AI companies.

What I like most about Oklo's approach is that it's pitching its products directly to data center businesses. Other SMR competitors, for comparison, are marketing their systems to utilities, which would then deliver that power over the grid to data centers in a conventional manner. This strategy may also work. But the rapid growth in electricity demand isn't stemming from grid users in general; AI companies are by far the biggest culprit. So why not market directly to them, especially given their deep budgets and urgency, not to mention the unique ability of SMRs to be colocated with data center infrastructure?

Oklo will remain a speculative stock until it secures regulatory approvals and demonstrates it can translate its designs into real-world applications with proven costs. But the business model is undoubtedly exciting with huge long-term opportunities.

news.Title: Anthropic Has a New Problem Before IPO
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Amazon ( NASDAQ:AMZN ) backed Anthropic's most advanced AI model is struggling to win over corporate customers, raising an uncomfortable question ahead of a potentially massive IPO: how much will businesses actually pay for frontier AI? Spending on Anthropic's flagship Fable 5 model has stalled near 11% of total spending on the company's models, as enterprises increasingly choose cheaper alternatives from Anthropic itself and rivals such as DeepSeek.

Warning! GuruFocus has detected 5 Warning Sign with AMZN.

Is AMZN fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator.

Anthropic develops the Claude family of artificial intelligence models and sells access through subscriptions, APIs and enterprise contracts. Its business depends on convincing companies that higher-performing models can generate enough productivity gains to justify their steep computing costs.

That equation is now being tested. More than two months after launch, Fable 5 accounts for roughly 11% of spending on Anthropic models, little changed from 11.4% after its first month. Ramp data covering tens of thousands of businesses suggests customers are increasingly prioritizing price-to-performance over simply buying the newest model.

Price is the obvious pressure point. Anthropic charges roughly $10 to $50 per million tokens for Fable 5 depending on the workload, while comparable DeepSeek offerings can cost less than $1 per million tokens.

That gap matters because many routine commercial workloads may not require frontier-level performance. Accel partner Miles Clements said the period when customers mainly chose frontier models was not a durable era.

The timing is especially sensitive. Anthropic has confidentially filed for an IPO and could list as soon as September or October. Reuters reported that the company's revenue run rate exceeded $65 billion in July and that Anthropic is targeting roughly $190 billion to $200 billion of annual revenue by 2028.

Investor Takeaway

For prospective Anthropic investors, the key metric may no longer be raw model performance but monetization efficiency.

Watch the mix of revenue coming from premium versus lower-cost models, inference costs, operating margins and whether enterprise customers upgrade when new models launch. If Anthropic can move users toward cheaper products while still expanding total spending, Fable 5's weak adoption may matter less.

But if pricing competition forces the company to cut rates while infrastructure costs remain high, margins could come under pressure just as investors are asked to support a potentially enormous valuation. Anthropic's reported push toward a roughly $2 trillion IPO makes that risk particularly important: premium valuations require not only rapid revenue growth, but evidence that frontier AI can generate durable pricing power.

news.Title: Intel Urges Enterprises to Put AI ROI Ahead of Hardware Specs
news.Content:
Key Points

Interested in Intel Corporation? Here are five stocks we like better.

Intel says enterprises should prioritize AI ROI over hardware specifications by defining the business problem, expected productivity gains and cost economics before selecting infrastructure.

AI workloads vary significantly: interactive applications require low latency, while batch tasks can use less expensive resources. Agentic AI also depends on orchestration, security, memory, storage, networking and data access—not just token-generation speed.

Enterprises can improve returns through observability, prompt optimization, caching, efficient agent loops and matching model costs to specific tasks. Intel is positioning its CPUs, GPUs and planned Crescent Island accelerator for heterogeneous, cost- and energy-efficient AI deployments across on-premises, cloud and hybrid environments.

The Trade Desk's Earnings Miss Raises a Bigger Question About Its AI Future

Enterprise AI infrastructure decisions should be centered on return on investment rather than hardware specifications alone, according to Anil Nanduri, vice president of AI Products and Go-To-Market for Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) Data Center.

Speaking during The Six Five Summit: AI Unleashed 2026, Nanduri said organizations moving from AI pilots into production need to identify the business problem they intend to solve, the expected productivity gains and the cost economics before selecting infrastructure.

→ Rocket Lab's Sell-Off Is Fading—Is It Finally Safe to Buy?

Intel's Rally Gave It a $20 Billion Opportunity and Now Comes the Hard Part

"A lot of our customers, they start thinking about hardware first," Nanduri said. "I think we really have to change the conversation to ROI."

Token efficiency and workload requirements

Nanduri said enterprises should not treat all AI tokens as equal. Some use cases demand low-latency, interactive responses, such as credit-card fraud protection, while other applications, including audit-report generation, can be handled in batch mode with less urgency.

→ What Rising Delivery Forecasts Say About Rivian's Stock Prospects

3 Humanoid Robot ETFs to Ride a Speculative Trend

Rather than pursuing the highest possible token output, companies should focus on using tokens efficiently to achieve a business result, he said. That distinction becomes more significant as companies deploy agentic AI systems designed to plan, coordinate and execute tasks rather than simply generate responses.

Agentic workloads require more than token generation, Nanduri said. They also require systems for code execution, testing, verification, sandboxing, orchestration, security and access to enterprise data. CPUs can play a role in execution, verification and control-plane functions, while GPUs and other accelerators can support different token-generation requirements.

Story Continues

→ Travel + Leisure Goes Big—Is It Ready to Rally?

"The wall clock time has shifted from just the AI running to actually waiting on answers," Nanduri said, referring to the time required for an end-to-end workflow to access data and interact with applications across an enterprise.

He said organizations should assess complete system throughput rather than evaluate a single component in isolation. Agentic applications may put pressure on memory, storage, databases, networking and application programming interfaces as they retrieve information from separate financial, supply-chain and customer systems.

Measuring AI business value

Nanduri said observability is important for managing AI costs and determining ROI. He cited comments from Uber executives regarding efforts to reduce AI implementation costs while expanding AI use, describing an approach that included improving operational efficiency, providing users visibility into token consumption and determining where expensive portions of an AI workflow reside.

According to Nanduri, enterprises can reduce costs by improving prompts, context caching and agent loops, allowing them to reach the same result with fewer tokens. They can also match model choices to specific portions of a workload.

He said frontier models may be appropriate for some tasks but can be expensive, while open-weight models may be sufficient for other work. A company could use lower-cost models for a large portion of a workflow and reserve more expensive AI capabilities for tasks that require them, he said.

Nanduri expects AI deployments to develop into hybrid environments, similar to the mix of on-premises and cloud infrastructure that emerged over time. Those environments could include local systems, lower-cost cloud services and more expensive cloud resources depending on workload needs.

Infrastructure layers and data strategy

For enterprise planning, Nanduri described several infrastructure layers that need to be balanced:

Control plane: Orchestration, model routing, agent routing and security controls, typically supported by CPUs.

Agent or data plane: Token generation, task execution, sandboxing and verification, using CPUs, GPUs or other compute architectures based on performance and cost needs.

Network plane: Connectivity across chips, servers, racks and data centers as models and workloads expand.

Storage and data systems: Databases, KV cache, context-memory pooling and access to enterprise information.

Investments need to be aligned across those layers, Nanduri said, because a weakness in orchestration, storage or networking can limit the benefits of token-generation improvements.

He also characterized enterprise data protection as a central strategic issue. As AI models seek more data for training and refinement, companies must decide whether to send their data to external AI services or bring AI tools to where their data resides, he said.

Nanduri said enterprises can use open-weight models, fine-tuning and model distillation to create smaller, domain-specific models suited to their own data. In his view, companies that protect their data while deploying AI capabilities around it will be better positioned for business success.

Intel's approach

Nanduri said Intel's strategy is based on heterogeneous computing, combining CPUs, GPUs and other compute elements for different AI tasks. He pointed to Intel's Xeon processors, its Arc GPU lineup and its planned Crescent Island product as components of that approach.

He said Crescent Island was designed around cost and energy efficiency, using low-power DDR memory rather than GDDR or HBM memory. The product is intended to serve enterprise workloads that do not require the most latency-sensitive AI tokens and can be deployed through PCIe cards, he said.

Nanduri also highlighted Intel's partnership with SambaNova Systems for high-throughput, low-latency token generation for interactive workloads. Intel's broader objective, he said, is to offer building blocks that help customers optimize total cost of ownership and business outcomes across on-premises, cloud and hybrid deployments.

About Intel (NASDAQ:INTC)

Intel Corporation, founded in 1968 by Robert Noyce and Gordon E. Moore and headquartered in Santa Clara, California, is a leading global designer and manufacturer of semiconductor products. The company is historically notable for introducing the first commercial microprocessor and for driving the x86 architecture that underpins many personal computers and servers. Intel's core business spans the design, fabrication and marketing of processors, chipsets and related components for a wide range of computing applications.

Intel's product portfolio includes client and mobile processors marketed under brands such as Intel Core and Pentium, as well as high-performance Xeon processors for data centers and cloud infrastructure.

news.Title: 台股ETF受益人止跌回升 周增11.8萬人
news.Content:
【記者柯安聰台北報導】在經過連續2周降溫後，台股ETF受益人人數止跌回升。根據集保戶股權分散8月21日最新統計資料顯示，94檔台股ETF受益人數上周增加11.79萬人，總人數來到1851萬3684人，統計今年來還是增加了634萬194。雖然總人數未創新高，不過還是有包括00923、00927、00686R在內的12檔台股ETF受益人數領先逆勢創高。這15檔中以市值型、科技、反1為主，值得一提的是主動式台股ETF都未上榜，而台股反1包括00686R與00664R卻榜上有名。市場法人表示，當市場觀望氣氛濃厚，方向不明時，投資人可利用反向型ETF進行避險，甚至在市場整理階段創造獲利機會，充分掌握台股多空投資契機。

群益臺灣加權反1ETF（00686R）經理人洪祥益表示，台股投資環境瞬息萬變，對於既想投資台股市場，但又怕挑錯個股的投資人而言，台股槓反ETF無疑是不錯的投資工具，雖然對於台股中長期後市表現仍正向看待，不過操作上仍須留意主要央行貨幣政策變化與國際地緣政治情勢發展，台灣加權指數自波段低點反彈漲多之際，投資人可利用反向ETF進行短線空頭趨勢操作或空頭趨勢避險。

群益半導體收益ETF（00927）經理人謝明志指出，整體來看，股市短期不確定性仍高，不過長期來看，在AI成長趨勢不變下，科技題材類股仍將持續獲得資金青睞。面對類股輪動加劇的市況，投資人不妨善用結合科技、半導體題材，且有亮眼息收水準的台股ETF，除擁有成長題材還有息收護體，可為投資組合增加防禦力，是較佳的長線存股策略。

群益台ESG低碳50（00923）經理人邱郁茹表示，台灣已是全球最重要的AI創新產業中心。隨著AI商機不斷擴大，AI需求也轉變成長期、結構性需求，預期台股企業從上游晶片半導體廠商到下流零組件及組裝營運都將迎來高成長。AI題材與供應鏈需求具利多效益，台股成長有撐。投資人也不妨善用AI科技股含量高的台股市值型ETF來把握契機，因其能更全面的網羅受惠於AI趨勢的科技龍頭股，更不易錯過AI題材輪動下各相關類股的表現契機，有助為投資人掌握台股多頭行情。（自立電子報2026/8/25）

news.Title: New GENIUS Act Stablecoin Rules Are Coming By November. Here's What It Could Mean for the Crypto Market.
news.Content:
Last July, the GENIUS (Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins) Act was signed into law as the first comprehensive regulatory framework for payment stablecoins. Let's see what that act accomplished, when those rules will take effect, and how they'll affect the companies that rely on stablecoins.

What are stablecoins?

Stablecoins are cryptocurrencies pegged to stable fiat currency, such as the U.S. dollar or euro. They can be held without bank accounts, and their payments are settled 24/7, 365 days a year. They can be used for faster, cheaper money transfers than conventional bank transfers. They can be deposited into third-party lending platforms, automated market makers, and liquidity pools to earn higher yields than bank savings accounts.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

What did the GENIUS Act change?

The GENIUS Act required stablecoins to be backed by U.S. dollars, short-term Treasuries, or central bank deposits at a 1:1 reserve ratio, rather than riskier, opaquely collateralized assets. Stablecoin issuers were also required to submit monthly attestations for those reserves.

The act required large issuers, with more than $10 billion in stablecoins in circulation, to be overseen by federal regulators. Smaller issuers with less than $10 billion could opt to be regulated at the state level, provided their state regulators met federal standards. All of those issuers were barred from paying passive yields to stablecoin holders.

Stablecoin holders gained clearer consumer protections, including a legal right to redeem their tokens for U.S. dollars on demand. If an issuer became insolvent, its stablecoin holders would be paid before its general creditors. Lastly, the act placed stablecoins outside the jurisdiction of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) by classifying them as neither securities nor commodities.

What will happen in November?

The GENIUS Act was signed into law more than a year ago, but its full legal enforcement won't start until Jan. 18, 2027. Before that happens, the U.S. Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) will publish the final rules in November.

Before that publication, which sets the rules in stone, several key parts of the act could still be modified based on the recent feedback from banks, stablecoin issuers, and consumer advocacy groups. That public comment period will remain open through Oct. 19.

Story Continues

The parts that could be tweaked include redemption extensions, which determine whether stablecoin issuers receive emergency extensions to liquidate their assets during market downturns; yield restrictions on edge cases (such as loyalty points or gas-fee discounts); and refinements to its framework for state-level certifications.

What does that mean for stablecoin-driven companies?

The publication of the GENIUS Act's final rules in November could drive more investors toward Circle (NYSE: CRCL), Coinbase (NASDAQ: COIN), and Mastercard (NYSE: MA).

Circle issues USD Coin (CRYPTO: USDC), the leading stablecoin in the U.S. market. Circle backs the USD Coin with its own cash and Treasury reserves, and the interest (reserve income) it collects on those holdings accounts for most of its top line. As Circle mints more stablecoins, its reserves will grow, boosting its profits. Coinbase, which co-developed USD Coin with Circle, collects all the reserve income from those stablecoins hosted on its platform.

Mastercard, which started working with Circle five years ago, is using stablecoins to accelerate its cross-border disbursements, treasury operations, and merchant payouts. It integrated its money transfer tools into stablecoin wallets in over 130 countries, and it expects stablecoins to gradually replace slower, older methods of transferring money.

The passage of the GENIUS Act is a clear vote of confidence for those faster financial rails. While stablecoins might seem like dull investments -- since they're pinned to stable fiat currencies -- their acceptance as a fully regulated cryptocurrency could generate strong tailwinds for the companies that are minting them and adopting them.

news.Title: Alphabet (GOOGL) Raised $3.9B After Free Cash Flow Turned Negative. Is AI Spending Becoming a Risk?
news.Content:
Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ: GOOGL ) raised A$5.5 billion, or approximately $3.9 billion, through its inaugural Australian-dollar bond offering on August 19. The deal included three-, five-, 10-, and 20-year maturities, with a 6.9% coupon on the longest tranche. Orders exceeded A$18 billion, more than three times the amount issued. The timing was notable: Alphabet had recently reported its first negative quarterly free cash flow as a public company after capital expenditures exceeded operating cash flow. For Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL), the question is whether the transaction represents prudent financing diversification or another sign that AI infrastructure is changing the balance-sheet profile of one of technology's strongest cash generators.

Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) remains operationally strong. Second-quarter revenue increased 24% to $119.8 billion, while operating income rose 30% to $40.8 billion. Google Cloud revenue jumped 82% to $24.8 billion, and its operating margin expanded to 35.6%. However, capital expenditures doubled to $44.9 billion against $39.1 billion of operating cash flow, producing negative non-GAAP free cash flow of $5.9 billion. Trailing-12-month free cash flow remained positive at $53.3 billion.

Bull Case: Strong Demand Provides Financing Flexibility

The bull case for Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) begins with the bond order book. Demand exceeding A$18 billion allowed the company to spread borrowing across four maturities rather than depend on a single refinancing date. The offering further diversified Alphabet's funding currencies beyond the U.S. dollar market, following earlier transactions in sterling, Swiss francs, euros and yen.

Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) is borrowing while its core businesses and operating income are expanding, although the specific use of proceeds from the Australian offering was not disclosed. Cloud growth and margin expansion provide early evidence that infrastructure investments are producing revenue and operating leverage. If the assets support AI search, cloud computing, and model deployment for many years, matching them with longer-term debt can be more efficient than funding every investment from current-period cash.

Bear Case: Fundraising Is Becoming Repetitive

The concern is that Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) has moved from occasional borrowing to repeated capital-market fundraising. Management raised its 2026 capital-expenditure forecast to $195 billion-$205 billion, suggesting that the second-quarter cash deficit may not be the peak of the spending cycle. Additional debt also introduces interest and refinancing obligations that were previously less important to the investment case.

Story Continues

Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) generated enough operating cash to fund enormous capital programs for years. The first negative quarter shows that this internal funding advantage has narrowed as AI spending accelerated. If monetization develops more slowly than infrastructure commitments, debt could continue rising while buybacks and other shareholder returns face greater competition for cash.

Insider Monkey's Hedge Fund Data

Insider Monkey's hedge fund database shows that 265 hedge funds held positions in Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) at the end of the first quarter of 2026, compared with 288 funds at the end of the preceding quarter. These figures reflect holdings as of March 31 and do not capture trades made after that date or investors' reactions to the Australian-dollar bond offering.

Conclusion

Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) executed the bond sale well, and the oversubscribed order book shows strong investor demand for the Australian-dollar notes at the offered terms. The transaction does not create an immediate balance-sheet problem, but it reinforces how quickly AI has increased the company's capital intensity. The decisive test is whether cloud and AI revenue can grow fast enough to restore positive quarterly free cash flow before repeated fundraising becomes a permanent feature.

While we acknowledge the potential of GOOGL as an investment, we believe certain AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. news.Title: Apple Just Massively Raised Stakes in AI PC Race
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Apple ( NASDAQ:AAPL ) has officially launched a new Mac mini powered by its M6 chip, turning what had been a reported product refresh into a much bigger push around on-device artificial intelligence. The new desktop gives investors a clearer look at how aggressively Apple plans to use its custom silicon to make the Mac a more capable local AI computing platform.

Warning! GuruFocus has detected 4 Warning Signs with NVDA.

Is AAPL fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator.

Apple unveiled the M6 alongside the M5 Ultra on Tuesday, with M6 powering the new Mac mini and M5 Ultra going into the new Mac Studio. M6 is Apple's first chip built on a 2-nanometer process and includes a 12-core CPU, 12-core GPU, Dual 16-core Neural Engine and up to 170GB per second of unified memory bandwidth.

The Mac mini is Apple's compact desktop computer and offers a lower-cost entry point into the Mac ecosystem. Revenue is reported within Apple's Mac segment, alongside products including the MacBook Air, MacBook Pro, iMac and Mac Studio.

The AI angle is particularly important. Apple said the M6 Neural Engine can deliver up to twice the peak compute of previous generations, while the chip's GPU provides nearly 30% more peak AI compute than M5 and more than eight times that of the original M1.

M6 also supports up to 32GB of unified memory and as much as 170GB per second of memory bandwidth, allowing users to run large language models and agentic AI tasks directly on the device. Apple specifically highlighted coding, file indexing and agentic AI workloads among the applications benefiting from the new chip.

That gives Apple a more direct way to capitalize on growing developer interest in running AI models locally rather than relying entirely on cloud infrastructure. Apple said its Core AI, Core ML, Metal and Xcode frameworks can tap directly into the new hardware, allowing developers to run and fine-tune large AI models on Macs.

Investor Takeaway

For Apple investors, the launch shifts the Mac mini story from speculation about timing to a test of whether substantially stronger AI performance can drive another upgrade cycle for the Mac business.

The most important signal may be Apple's decision to make M6 its first 2-nanometer chip. Moving to a smaller process can improve performance and power efficiency, but it also puts greater importance on Apple's access to leading-edge manufacturing capacity. Apple says M6 delivers up to 1.2 times M5 multithreaded CPU performance while increasing peak GPU AI compute by nearly 30%.

Story Continues

Investors should now watch Mac revenue growth, Mac mini demand, pricing, product availability and whether developer adoption of local AI workloads translates into a meaningful replacement cycle.

Apple is also attacking the higher end of the AI computing market with M5 Ultra in Mac Studio. The chip supports up to 512GB of unified memory and 1.2TB per second of memory bandwidth, allowing some large AI models with hundreds of billions of parameters to run entirely on-device.

If demand for both machines proves strong, Apple could begin turning its silicon advantage into a more visible AI-driven growth catalyst for the Mac business rather than treating Apple Intelligence primarily as an iPhone story.

news.Title: Rosenblatt Resets Marvell Stock Target Before Earnings
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Marvell Technology ( NASDAQ:MRVL ) drew another bullish analyst call ahead of earnings, with Rosenblatt Securities raising its price target to $300 from $240 while keeping a Buy rating. The upgrade reflects growing confidence that Marvell's custom AI silicon and optical interconnect businesses can support substantially higher earnings power over the next several years, giving investors another reason to focus on Thursday's fiscal second-quarter report.

Warning! GuruFocus has detected 5 Warning Sign with AMZN.

Is AMZN fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator.

Marvell supplies data-infrastructure semiconductors used across cloud, networking, storage and AI systems. Increasingly, its growth story centers on custom AI accelerators, optical connectivity and networking products sold to hyperscalers including Microsoft ( NASDAQ:MSFT ), Amazon ( NASDAQ:AMZN ) and Google ( NASDAQ:GOOG ).

Rosenblatt analyst Sajal Dogra expects strong second-quarter results, helped by more than 25% sequential growth in optical interconnects. The firm also sees major custom-silicon ramps in fiscal 2028 and 2029 tied to Microsoft Maia, AWS Trainium and Marvell's expanded Google relationship.

That Google deal has become particularly important. Marvell disclosed this month that Google could purchase up to $120 billion of custom products through fiscal 2033, with warrant vesting tied largely to cumulative purchases. The expanded partnership spans AI inference accelerators, storage controllers, networking chips and other products around Google's TPU ecosystem.

Rosenblatt estimates Marvell could generate roughly $10.50 in fiscal 2029 earnings, applying a 29-times multiple to reach its new $300 target. The firm argues rising chip-development costs increasingly favor scaled suppliers like Marvell because intellectual property can be reused across customers and platforms.

Investor Takeaway

The immediate catalyst is Marvell's fiscal Q2 earnings on Thursday, Aug. 27, followed by its Investor Day on Oct. 6. Investors should watch optical-interconnect growth, custom-silicon revenue visibility and any change to management's fiscal 2028 and 2029 framework.

Rosenblatt does not expect those longer-term targets to be reset this week, making October potentially more important for the stock's valuation. Strong Q2 execution and greater visibility into Microsoft, AWS and Google ramps would support the $300 thesis. Slower hyperscaler deployments, weaker margins or delays in custom-chip programs would make Rosenblatt's 29-times fiscal 2029 earnings multiple harder to justify.

news.Title: ARM's 93X Earnings Multiple Overshadows Its Growth Potential
news.Content:
Arm Holdings ARM appears positioned to deliver another strong quarter, but its elevated valuation leaves little room for execution missteps.

The Zacks Consensus Estimate for the company's fiscal second-quarter revenues is $1.37 billion, indicating 21% year-over-year growth. Royalty revenues could accelerate sequentially as artificial intelligence, data-center and smartphone demand support wider adoption of Arm-based technology. Licensing revenues may also benefit from new agreements and customers adopting more advanced architectures.

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

The consensus mark for fiscal second-quarter adjusted earnings stands at 48 cents per share, indicating 23% year-over-year growth. Stronger-than-expected revenues could provide operating leverage and lift adjusted earnings. Full-year earnings could consequently approach $2.20 per share, up 24% year over year. With gross margin exceeding 98% in the fiscal first quarter, operating expenses will remain a crucial determinant of profitability. Research and development investments are likely to rise sharply, while selling, general and administrative costs should also increase.

ARM's financial position remains another notable strength. The company exited the previous quarter with approximately $3.06 billion in cash and no debt. Free cash flow could reach the mid-$1 billion range this year, although that would still represent a yield of only about 0.5% at the current valuation.

Synopsys and Cadence Design Systems Offer Valuation Context

Synopsys SNPS trades at roughly 24 times forward earnings, while Cadence Design Systems CDNS commands about 35 times. Although Arm Holdings' profitability can justify a premium to Synopsys, its multiple of more than 93 times earnings appears excessive. Cadence Design Systems also benefits from durable semiconductor-design demand, yet remains substantially cheaper. Compared with Synopsys and Cadence Design Systems, ARM's valuation assumes exceptionally favorable growth for years while making the stock vulnerable to a sharp correction and offering investors an inadequate margin of safety.

ARM currently carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold). You can see the complete list of today's Zacks #1 Rank (Strong Buy) stocks here.
